adjust.definitionKo: 굽거나 비뚤어지거나 흐트러진 것을 곧고 바르게 하다.
adjust.englishDescription: To straighten up and correct something curved, crooked or distorted.

adjust.definitionKo: 어떤 기준이나 상황에 맞게 바로잡아 정리하다.
adjust.englishDescription: To correct and adjust in accordance with a certain standard or circumstances.

adjust.definitionKo: 어떠한 조건이나 환경에 익숙해지거나 알맞게 변화하다.
adjust.englishDescription: To get accustomed to, or change to fit into, a condition or environment.
To clear one's throat or adjust one's breath.

adjust.definitionKo: 환경이나 변화에 알맞게 되어 익숙해지거나 체계, 명령 등에 순순히 따르다.
adjust.englishDescription: To get used to an environment or change, or obediently follow a system, order, etc.
To make something meet a requirement or reach a level.
To adjust something to meet a certain standard.
To make the number or quantity of something become specific.

adjust.definitionKo: 어떠한 조건이나 환경에 익숙해지게 하거나 알맞게 변화하게 하다.
adjust.englishDescription: To cause someone or something to get accustomed to, or change to fit into, a condition or environment.

bedclothes.definitionKo: 잘 때 몸을 덮기 위해 천 등으로 만든 것.
bedclothes.englishDescription: Something made of fabric, etc., to cover a person's body when sleeping.

bill.definitionKo: 물건의 값이 적힌 종이. 또는 요금의 자세한 내용이 적힌 종이.
bill.englishDescription: Paper containing the price of a product or service, or the details of the price.

bill.definitionKo: 법으로 제정하고자 하는 사항을 항목별로 정리하여 국회에 제출하는 문서나 안건.
bill.englishDescription: The document or draft submitted to the National Assembly containing provisions by category, intended to become a new law.
A hard and sharp part of a bird's mouth.

bill.definitionKo: 일정한 금액을 일정한 날짜와 장소에서 지불할 것을 약속하거나 다른 사람에게 그 지급을 맡기는 유가 증권.
bill.englishDescription: A type of securities where a person promises to pay a certain amount of money in a specific place, or the one that he/she entrusts others with paying.

bill.definitionKo: 돈은 나중에 내기로 하고 사거나 판 물건의 값.
bill.englishDescription: The price of goods sold or bought on a promise of future payment.
An item that is to be discussed in a meeting.

bill.definitionKo: 다른 사람에게 돈이나 물건 등을 달라고 요구하는 내용을 적은 문서.
bill.englishDescription: A document that requests another person to give money, objects, etc.

bill.definitionKo: 햇볕을 가리기 위해 모자의 끝에 댄 부분.
bill.englishDescription: A piece of fabric attached to the front of a cap to block sunlight.

bill.definitionKo: 입법하기 위해 가장 처음에 내놓는 안건.
bill.englishDescription: A draft proposal presented before making it a law.

branchia.definitionKo: 물속에서 사는 동물이 숨을 쉴 수 있게 하는 기관.
branchia.englishDescription: A breathing organ of an water animal.

defending.definitionKo: 가진 물건이나 힘, 의견 등을 굳게 지킴.
defending.englishDescription: The attitude of sticking firmly to an opinion or defending one's possessions or power.

dwi-ungbak.definitionKo: 박을 가르지 않고 윗부분만 동그랗게 도려내어 그 속을 파낸 바가지.
dwi-ungbak.englishDescription: The shell of a calabash that is hollowed out after cutting off its top using a circular motion instead of cutting it in half.

entrust.definitionKo: 손해나 빚 또는 책임 등을 맡게 하다.
entrust.englishDescription: To make someone suffer a loss, have a debt, or bear the responsibility for something.

entrust.definitionKo: 물건이나 권리, 책임, 일 등을 다른 사람에게 주거나 맡기다.
entrust.englishDescription: To give goods, rights, obligations, tasks, etc., over to another person, or entrust such things to him/her.
To leave a task or duty to another person.

entrust.definitionKo: 자신의 일이나 사물을 다른 사람에게 완전히 맡기다.
entrust.englishDescription: To entrust someone entirely with a job or possession.
To entrust someone with a position or task.
To have someone take responsibility in handling a certain work.

entrust.definitionKo: 가지고 있던 것을 특정 장소에 두거나 다른 사람에게 주어 보관하게 하다.
entrust.englishDescription: To place what one carries in a specific place or give it to someone to keep temporarily.

entrust.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 다른 사람에게 책임지도록 맡기다.
entrust.englishDescription: To leave a matter to someone so that he/she takes charge of it.

entrust.definitionKo: 남에게 사물이나 사람에 대한 책임을 맡게 하다.
entrust.englishExpression: entrust; trust; put something in charge of someone
entrust.englishDescription: To place the responsibility for a thing or person on someone.

entrust.definitionKo: 남에게 사무 등의 일을 맡게 하다.
entrust.englishDescription: To leave a task, etc., in someone's charge.
To ask someone to take charge of a task, and then leave it his/her hands.

entrust.definitionKo: 일이나 권한 등을 모두 다 맡기다.
entrust.englishExpression: entrust; leave in another person's hands
entrust.englishDescription: To give all of one's responsibilities, authority, etc., over to someone else.

entrust.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 해 달라고 부탁하여 맡기다.
entrust.englishDescription: To ask someone to take the responsibility of doing a certain job.
To entrust someone with a task.

equator.definitionKo: 지구의 중심을 지나는 자전축에 수직인 평면과 지표가 교차되는 선.
equator.englishDescription: A line where the earth's surface meets with a cross section perpendicular to the rotational axis that runs through the center of the earth.

explosive.definitionKo: 불이 일어나며 갑자기 터지는 성질이 있는 물질.
explosive.englishDescription: Substance that has the trait that makes a fire and explodes suddenly.

explosive.definitionKo: 열, 전기, 충격 등의 자극을 가하면 순간적으로 폭발하는 고체 또는 액체 상태의 물질.
explosive.englishDescription: A solid or liquid substance that explodes on contact with stimulators such as heat, electricity, shock, etc.

fluctuation.englishDescription: An increase or decrease; a rise or fall.

heading.definitionKo: 남보다 먼저 어떤 일을 시작해 앞장서 나감.
heading.englishDescription: The act of starting a certain task earlier than others

heading.definitionKo: 축구에서, 공중으로 떠오른 공을 머리로 받음. 또는 그런 동작.
heading.englishDescription: In soccer, an act of heading a ball in the air; or such a motion.

memoirs.definitionKo: 자기가 겪은 일을 직접 기록한 글.
memoirs.englishDescription: A writing that contains one's own account of one's experiences.

memoirs.definitionKo: 지난 일을 다시 생각하며 하는 이야기.
memoirs.englishDescription: A talk carried out while looking back on one's past.

policy.definitionKo: 사회생활에 필요한 일정한 방식이나 기준을 법이나 제도로 정하는 것.
policy.englishDescription: The practice of establishing a method or standard needed for social interaction.

policy.definitionKo: 국가나 행정 기관이 정한 계획이나 정책을 시행함. 또는 그 정책.
policy.englishDescription: The act of enforcing a plan or policy decided by the government or administrative body, or such a policy.
A way to accomplish political aims.
A rule or regulation that serves as a basis or standard.

pure.definitionKo: 빛깔이나 색깔이 진하지 않고 옅은 느낌을 주면서 산뜻하다.
pure.englishDescription: A color or light being pale, fresh, not deep.
A person's face or spirit being lively and clear.

pure.definitionKo: 마음이나 표정이 사납거나 험하지 않고 순수하다.
pure.englishDescription: One's mind or facial expression being innocent, not fierce or harsh.
Not being adulterated with other things.
Clean and unmixed with any filth.

pure.definitionKo: 마음에 나쁜 감정이나 생각이 없이 깨끗하다.
pure.englishDescription: Purehearted and free from any bad feeling or thought.

pure.definitionKo: 다른 것이 전혀 섞이지 않아 매우 깨끗하다.

pure.englishDescription: Clear and beautiful without any flaw.
Beautiful in a way that is pure and clear rather than glamorous.
One's face or laughter being bright and pure.

redcap.englishDescription: A person employed to carry or move luggage, parcels, etc.

room.definitionKo: 여관이나 호텔 등에서 손님이 묵는 방.
room.englishDescription: A room in a hotel, inn, etc., where a guest stays.

room.definitionKo: 사람이 살거나 일을 하기 위해 벽을 둘러서 막은 공간.
room.englishDescription: A space enclosed by walls for residential or business purposes.
(slang) A room or the inside of a room.
A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting the number of rooms.

room.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 수 있는 방법이나 어떤 일이 일어날 가능성.
room.englishDescription: A method used to do a certain thing or its possibility of happening.
Each and every room that makes up a house.
A room which a certain number is assigned to.

spin-off.definitionKo: 중심이 되거나 기본적인 물건을 만들 때 딸려 생기는 물건.
spin-off.englishDescription: Something produced in the making of another thing that is main and fundamental.

spin-off.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 할 때 딸려서 일어나는 일이나 현상.
spin-off.englishDescription: A thing or phenomenon that comes into being in doing something else.

spin-off.definitionKo: 근본이 되는 어떤 것으로부터 갈려 나와 생김.
spin-off.englishDescription: The state of something forming by diverging from something else which is the base.

taiwan.definitionKo: 중국 대륙의 남동 해안에 있는 섬. 1949년 중국 공산당과의 내전에서 패배한 국민당 정권이 이곳으로 옮겨 왔다. 주요 도시는 타이베이이며, 제조업과 국제 무역이 발달하였다.
taiwan.englishDescription: An island located off the southeastern coast of continental China; the Kuomintang or the Nationalist Party defeated by the Communist Party of China in the civil war in 1949 moved to this island; its capital is Taipei; manufacturing and international trade are developed.

taiwan.definitionKo: 중국 대륙의 남동 해안에 있는 섬. ‘타이완’을 한국식 한자음으로 읽은 이름이다.
taiwan.englishDescription: An island located off the southeastern coast of continental China; it is the Korean pronunciation of the Chinese characters for Taiwan.

timetable.definitionKo: 기차, 자동차, 배, 비행기 등이 출발하고 도착하는 시간을 적어 놓은 표.
timetable.englishDescription: A table that contains the times of departure and arrival of a train, car, ship, plane, etc.

troubleshooter.definitionKo: 특정 분야의 일 처리를 아주 잘하는 사람.
troubleshooter.englishDescription: A person who handles a task in a certain field very well.
